text: Nice color. Really nice blue colors, but the ends of the spatulas are a little wonky, but they will do- so far have not melted during use.

product_metadata.title: U-Taste High Heat Resistant Silicone Spoon Spatula Set
features: [Not just make it, we upgrade it.] We are a professional kitchenware producer who have been focus on customer experience. In order to offer better and eco-friendly kitchenware, U-Taste collects customer reviews of all similar products on Amazon. And then upgrade the products based on the data of the bad evaluation with the aim to provide customers with more perfect kitchenware products.

[600°F high temperature rating] 17.59% customers bought inferior silicone spatulas which have a strong odor and melt easily in high temperature. U-Taste uses superior material - the same material as baby nipple, which is BPA FREE and can tolerate high temperatures up to 600°F. The handle will not get too hot to hold while cooking.

[Seamless integrated design for easy cleaning] Are you tired of the handle of your current two-piece silicone spatula frequently separating from the blade as 40.67% customers complaint. Now, try this seamless set, no funky gunk getting under the silicone! Also dishwasher safe to meet the needs of 7.05% customers. Never worry about a white hazy film on them.

[Right amount of blade flexibility for effective scraping] You may be sick of silicone either too stiff or too soft as 21.95% reviews have suffered. These seriously strike the perfect balance. Slight flex at the tip, that moves into a nice sturdy handle. They are well balanced in the hand and do an excellent job of blending even dense material like bread dough.

[3 Different colors for different cooking baking tasks] This set includes 3 different colors spoon spatulas. Great for cooking and spooning your food into serving dishes or onto plates as well as using while prepping baking goods. The silicone handle provides a firm solid smooth grip to meet 3.29% buyers’ need.
